target_policy: Original synthesis intent only, with the original alias mapping for Nyx/Nix/Nicks. These are fixed dictionary-like hypotheses, not measured phones, teacher decodes or human pronunciation truth. Retain original binary source roles. Correct true CTC lengths 6/6/7/5; zero padding is excluded by true lengths.
readout: For each held/fitted crop, raw CTC log likelihood for each of the four predefined intent strings with equal priors. No score length correction, forced probability normalization, fitted margin or wake threshold. Unequal phone target lengths are retained. Also record greedy exact strings/edit rates and normalized true-label loss. Forced-choice metrics are not open-set false-wake rates.
scope: Training-only generative versus combined conditional phone CTC intent fit; no wake acceptance.
hypothesis: Neutral initialization fixes much of complete phone-sequence fit but Mix->Nyx remains415/448. Per-token generative CTC averages the local identity error over shared target phones and does not explicitly normalize among near-phrase hypotheses. Test adding a fixed four-intent conditional likelihood cross-entropy,with original intent labels,no pronunciation edits or teacher labels. A change in this full-fit recipe cannot establish a general causal diagnosis or open-set wake improvement.
objective: For each sample,retain CTC_NLL(true_phone_string)/true_token_length. Treatment adds exactly1*CE(softmax of the four raw phone-string CTC log likelihoods),true intent. Equal intent prior,no fitted score/length adjustment. Mean each term over the same32 original examples. Conditional likelihoods sum the same CTC paths as the existing readout;compute loss/gradient in TensorFlow without NumPy.
